coordinate_system.z: air (z>0, incident side) | pattern at z=0 | substrate (-h<z<0) | air (z<-h); no ground plane

reference_wave.quantity: monopole-launched guided surface wave (Formulation A) or an arbitrary reference field (Formulation B)

object_wave.definition: E_obj(x,y) = sum_n w_n exp(j*phi0_n) exp(-j(kx0_n x + ky0_n y)) at z=0

multi_beam.definition: field-level complex superposition, weight = complex field-amplitude coefficient

formulations.name: A: Fong et al. 2010 interference-modulation index (grounded holographic impedance surface)
formulations.required_quantity: surface reactance X(x,y) of a grounded, surface-wave-supporting structure

formulations.name: B: phase-difference hologram (reflectarray/transmitarray-style)
formulations.required_quantity: normal-incidence co-polarized reflection or transmission phase (S11xx or S21xx)

control_variable.physical_definition: unresolved: see holographic_modulation.formulations for both candidates
